elements.caption: Configure the Symcon variables that can act as alarm sensors or triggers.

items.caption: Enabled makes an area available but does not arm it. The required area main is the complete alarm system; it must stay enabled.

The area main is the fixed complete alarm system. Additional areas can be switched independently. Silent by default suppresses signal generators; the arming command can override it. Area IDs must start with a lowercase letter and may contain up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (for example garage or area_1). The name is freely selectable.
Configure the shared Symcon tile theme used by the HTML-SDK visualization.
Configure the shared IPSView style used by the standalone HTML page.
In IPSView, use an HTML-Box with the client browser renderer so JavaScript and the controls are available.
A value of 0 disables the corresponding delay.
Optional. Runs exactly once when an entry or exit delay starts. Use it for a single beep, an announcement or to switch on a continuous signal. If the list is empty, no start action runs.

Optional. Runs once for every remaining second while an entry or exit delay is active. Use it for a remaining-time announcement or a repeating signal. Scripts can read the remaining time, triggering sensor, arming mode and state through OHA_GetControlState(). If the list is empty, no per-second action runs.

Optional. Runs exactly once when a started entry or exit delay ends, both after normal expiry and after controlled cancellation by disarming or granting passage. Use it to switch off a continuous signal, light or status output. If the list is empty, no end action runs.

Optional. Runs exactly once when the last active alarm area has been successfully disarmed. It does not run when the system was already fully disarmed, while another area remains active, or after an internal arming cancellation.
Configure an optional numeric code for disarming from user-facing controls.
Leave empty to allow disarming without a code.
After too many failed attempts, code entry is blocked temporarily. Trusted automations can still use Disarm().
Configure weekly schedules that arm the system through the normal readiness checks, optionally bypassing permitted active sensors.
Only explicitly permitted, already triggered sensors can be bypassed by a schedule. 24/7 sensors, unavailable sensors and blocking faults still prevent arming. An active mode is never changed.
Configure all alarm actions as escalation steps. A step with a delay of 0 runs immediately when an alarm starts.
A value of 0 keeps the alarm output active until it is reset manually or the system is disarmed.
After the alarm duration ends, the affected area is re-armed in its previous mode only when every relevant sensor and blocking fault is ready.
Add one row for each escalation action. Actions with the same delay run together. Use the gear button to select the Symcon action.
Use the Home, Away, Night and 24/7 source matrix to decide which alarm origins may run each action. Existing actions remain enabled for all four categories.
Send a native Symcon push notification to the registered devices of a tile visualization. The notification contains the affected alarm area and triggering sensor.
The delay applies only to the delayed escalation mode. A value of 0 sends the push notification immediately. Tapping it opens this OpenHomeAlarm instance in the selected tile visualization.
Send alarm notifications directly through the Pushover HTTPS API. No additional Symcon module is required.

The delay is used only in delayed mode. Emergency priority repeats until acknowledged or expired; OpenHomeAlarm cancels an active emergency retry when the alarm output ends. Apply changes before testing.
Send Pushover test message

items.caption: Configure optional 24/7 inputs for tamper, battery/power, communication or device faults.
Configured sensor variables are checked periodically and immediately when Symcon reports their removal.
Optional: Add an action that runs once when a configured fault or a monitored sensor becomes faulty. Typical uses are a notification, spoken warning or warning light. An empty list runs no action.

items.name: FaultClearedAction
items.caption: Actions after all faults are cleared
Optional: Add an action that runs once after the last active fault has been cleared. Typical uses are an all-clear notification or switching off a warning light. An empty list runs no action.

options.caption: Trigger when different from normal value

elements.caption: Choose whether the selected value itself triggers an alarm or whether every deviation from a known normal value should trigger. Variables without discrete states keep a raw-value input.
24/7 sensors trigger immediately as normal alarms in every system state. Arming modes, entry/exit delays and temporary passage do not apply.
